== Notes ==
* This skill will activate only if you do not have an animal companion and the target is a [[charmable animal]]. 
** It can target [[Passive|friendly and hostile]] creatures, but not allies nor animals already charmed to be pets.
** If you try to use it on an invalid target, it will fail to activate (and you will see the relevant error message in red text).
* Once an animal is charmed, there is no special value to bringing this skill over [[Comfort Animal]] or [[Heal as One]] in PvE.
* Although this skill is unaffected by your rank in [[Beast Mastery]], your pet's attacks benefit from a higher rank and you recover more quickly if your pet dies.
* Even if you replace this skill with another (e.g. a [[mission]]-specific skill such as [[Disarm Trap]]), your pet will remain with you. If you rezone and retain the replacement skill, the pet will not zone with you.
* [[PvE character]]s and [[hero]]es have to charm their own pets; [[PvP]] players start off with an [[Elder]] [[Wolf]].
* Be careful when charming a pet with nearby heroes or henchmen: the target will become hostile and could be killed. To prevent this, flag your allies farther away and/or set heroes to avoid combat. 
* There are six [[Charm Animal (disambiguation)|special versions]] of this skill, notably the [[Charm Animal (Codex)|one]] used in the [[Codex Arena]].
{{anomaly|Although technically considered a pet, occasionally a charmed animal will retain the red wording associated with a hostile enemy just after completing the charm animal skill.}}

== Trivia ==
* This has the longest [[activation]] out of all the skills usable by players.
* Before the [[Game updates/20090423|Fourth Anniversary Update]], you could charm animals of any level.
* This was originally the only skill you could equip to bring a pet. [[Comfort Animal]] became the second such skill in the [[Feedback:Game_updates/20090806|August 6, 2009 game update]] and [[Heal as One]] was added on [[Feedback:Game_updates/20100225|February 25, 2010]].
* This skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
* During early alpha testing, this skill was called "Charm Lynx", as mentioned by an alpha tester in the Photics e-zine issue #3<ref>https://photics.com/issues/issue03.pdf</ref> of March 2004. Issue #4<ref>https://photics.com/issues/issue04.pdf</ref> of the e-zine implies that the [[Lynx]] was the only charmable pet at this point in alpha testing, hence the skill name. This also explains the skill icon depicting a Lynx.
